title: Ilse's spade on the creek's bank, a field waiting beside it
about: Spring 12, 09:00, on the running creek's west bank (25,10) facing west, the spade selected: two tilled rows of parsnips (y 9 and 11, x 19-24) sit dry. Hold Action and drag west: one drag digs a channel from the bank (the bank tile too) and the water follows the cut. Tomorrow morning the rows beside it are watered without the can.
